name: Review NewEra Task Completion
description: Kiểm tra evidence, status, residual work và handoff sau khi một task của Kiro kết thúc; không tự kết luận Phase.

then.prompt: Review the completed NewEra task only. Check its binding, task status, targeted tests, evidence, residual/blocker, commit/worktree reference and acceptance handoff. Do not infer Phase completion from this event, do not change scope, and do not mark acceptance automatically.
